title: Beef Wellington
description: A traditional United Kingdom dish made with beef tenderloin, dijon mustard, button mushroom, shallot. This home-style preparation follows its characteristic cooking method and uses measured ingredients.

steps.instruction: Pat the beef fillet dry, season and sear in a very hot pan with olive oil until browned all over; cool and brush with mustard.
Cook finely chopped mushrooms and shallots with butter until every trace of moisture evaporates and the duxelles is dry; cool completely.
Cover cooled beef with cold mushroom duxelles, wrap tightly in prosciutto and then in puff pastry; seal the edges underneath.
Chill the tightly wrapped raw Wellington seam-side down for at least 30 minutes, to help the pastry hold its shape.
Brush the pastry with beaten egg and bake at 200°C until golden and the beef reaches a safe internal temperature measured at its center; rest briefly before slicing.
